title: A Visit to Claas HQ in Harsewinkel - AgWeb
content: # A Visit to Claas HQ in Harsewinkel. ## In November a trip to Harsewinkel, Germany shows the place where Claas was founded and maintains at its worldwide headquarters today. Harsewinkel, Germany is the worldwide hub for the international farm machinery company Claas. Started by August Claas, today the company makes self-propelled combines for corn, soybeans, rice and small grains; self-propelled forage harvesters; haying equipment; and tractors. Claas has invested in new facilities in Omaha, Neb., Russia, and India with the purpose to producing machines where they will be used. The manufacturing facilities there produce self-propelled forage harvesters, Xerion machines, and combines for western Europe as well as threshing modules for other markets. It takes one day’s time to assembly a combine, and the factory produces 18 to 19 combines a day. There is a one assembly line dedicated to Jaguar forage harvesters, and there are 16 machines on the assembly at a time.

title: Claas – A WinGuard Success Story - Advancis
content: # **Claas** – A WinGuard Success Story. ## **Claas**. ## **The Challenge** – Security Management in agricultural Machinery Production. With corporate headquarters in Harsewinkel, Westphalia, CLAAS is the European market leader in combine harvesters. CLAAS is also a top performer in worldwide agricultural engineering with tractors, agricultural balers and green harvesting machinery. Harsewinkel is one of the most high-tech production plants of combines and agricultural choppers in the world. Furthermore, it encompasses the Technoparc, an exhibition center in which more than 30,000 interested visitors per year learn more about the agricultural machines of CLAAS and the company history. Video surveillance, intrusion detection as well as different building management technologies are indispensabale in order to guarantee the security of both employees and visitors. To be able to control all installed technical systems centrally via a unified operation interface, CLAAS has decided to use the Physical Security Information Management Platform WinGuard by Advancis. In case of an intrusion attempt, for example, the video image from the concerned area is immediately displayed in the control center.
